frozen_decision: Independent confirmation of paired original/repaired mechanism contrasts at N and 4N. Engine choice and no accuracy-improvement claim do not depend on confirmation outcomes. All 200 prespecified seeds retained, including failures. Oracle arms remain diagnostics.
primary_mechanism_endpoint: Per-dataset mean normalized Kendall distance to the three true group orders; compare repaired minus original paired by seed; also retain each group and consensus residuals.
secondary_endpoints: Per-group truth error; observed pair distances; optimizer flags; paired N vs 4N recovery. Oracle equal and known prior illustrate objective/initialization effects and are not inference candidates.
